sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: USE OF PROCEEDS We intend to contribute the net proceeds we receive from the sale by us of shares of our common stock under this prospectus supplement and the accompanying prospectus and from any forward sale agreement to the Operating Partnership in exchange for OP Units. We expect the Operating Partnership to use such net proceeds for general corporate purposes, which may include potential future investments. Pending the permanent use of the net proceeds we receive from the sale by us of shares of our common stock under this prospectus supplement and the accompanying prospectus and from any forward sale agreement, we intend to invest such net proceeds in interest-bearing, short-term investment-grade securities, money-market accounts or other investments that are consistent with our intention to qualify for taxation as a REIT for U.S. federal income tax purposes.
